segmentler.metin: The Port of Beirut was destroyed by a massive explosion.
It took only a fire in a warehouse storing ammonium nitrate.
So how could a fire in a warehouse storing ammonium nitrate do this?
The answer is fire heating a large, long-stored stockpile of ammonium nitrate until it detonated — and it is why ports worldwide reviewed hazardous material storage.
